title: Test first: modules listed and switched in config and the CLI
goal: `nerv modules` lists every module with on/off, reachable and tool count; `nerv modules on|off NAME` switches it, keeping grants

Off writes packs.<id>: false or off: true on the server entry; grants stay in config.json; On clears it
`nerv tools remove` still drops the server with its grants; an unknown module name is refused with how to list them
